boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named UNCW campus spaces for studying, meeting, programs, and recreation; check current building or facility rules before visiting.

cards.title: Randall Library Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Randall Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use the first-floor Learning Commons for computer-based work, printing, or a study reset; iPrint locations identify both its common area and guest-computer area.
cards.short_summary: A practical first-floor study and technology stop in Randall Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists iPrint stations in Randall Library’s first-floor Learning Commons Area and Guest Computer Area.
cards.access_notes: Library services and access may vary by term; confirm current library hours before going.

cards.title: Fisher Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Life facility
cards.notes: Meet collaborators in the building’s common areas, then use its event-space directory to identify a room for a planned gathering or presentation.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Life building with gathering spaces and the Lumina Theater.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW identifies the Fisher Student Center as a Campus Life facility with smaller meeting and gathering spaces.
cards.access_notes: Campus Life building hours and individual room availability vary; some uses require a reservation.

cards.title: Clock Tower Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fisher Student Center, room FSC 2000
cards.notes: Bring a small group or reading task to the permanent seating and tables, and take in the Campus Commons view from the wraparound windows.
cards.short_summary: A furnished lounge with Campus Commons views and a veranda.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW describes Clock Tower Lounge as having comfortable seating, small tables, a fireplace, large windows, and veranda access.
cards.access_notes: This is an event space; confirm whether it is open or reserved before relying on it for study.

cards.title: Lumina Theater
cards.subtitle: Fisher Student Center
cards.notes: Check the Campus Life calendar for film programming, panels, or presentations; the theater is a defined multi-use auditorium rather than a general lounge.
cards.short_summary: A campus auditorium used for films, panels, and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW says Lumina Theater in the Fisher Student Center is a multi-use auditorium for film programming, presentations, panels, and more.
cards.access_notes: Attend scheduled programming or arrange use through Campus Life; access is not guaranteed outside events.

cards.title: Fisher University Union
cards.subtitle: Campus Life facility
cards.notes: Use the Union as a coordination point for campus services, cultural hubs, or a reserved gathering; check the building directory for the office or room you need.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Life hub with services, cultural spaces, and event rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW states that Fisher University Union provides passport and mailing services and houses cultural hubs for African American and Latinx community members.
cards.access_notes: Campus Life building hours vary; offices and reservable rooms have their own availability.

cards.title: Town Square
cards.subtitle: Fisher University Union common area
cards.notes: Walk through when looking for fair tables or small exhibitions, and use the space as an easy landmark for meeting someone in the Union.
cards.short_summary: A Union common area designed for tabling and small exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW describes Town Square as a Fisher University Union common area with foot traffic, suitable for fair tabling and small exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Tabling and exhibitions are managed uses; check Campus Life procedures before setting up.

cards.title: Warwick Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Life facility
cards.notes: Stop here to find campus dining, departments, and services, or choose a quiet spot to pause between classes; check the building directory for current occupants.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Life building that combines services, dining, and informal space.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW says the Warwick Center hosts university departments, campus dining locations, and community services, and its facilities include lounges for friends or group work.
cards.access_notes: Campus Life facility hours vary by term; confirm the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: University Commons
cards.subtitle: Campus Life outdoor focal point
cards.notes: Use this named outdoor Campus Life area as a meetup point before an event, and check university event listings for any scheduled programming that changes access.
cards.short_summary: A named Campus Life outdoor area associated with campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW’s Code of Student Life identifies University Commons as one of the facilities serving as focal points for campus life outside the classroom.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access can be affected by scheduled events, weather, and university operations.

cards.title: UNCW Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Campus Life outdoor performance venue
cards.notes: Check for scheduled performances or student-organization programming, then use the amphitheater as a recognizable outdoor meeting point on the Campus Life side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor Campus Life venue for campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW’s Code of Student Life lists the Amphitheater among facilities that provide performance venues and serve as focal points for campus life.
cards.access_notes: Event activity and campus operations may affect access; follow posted university guidance.

cards.title: Shoreline Sports Complex
cards.subtitle: Between Pat Leonard Student Recreation Center and Terrapin/Pelican Hall
cards.notes: Plan an outdoor activity around the courts, fields, or fitness area, and check the posted facility schedule before arriving because programming can take priority.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor recreation complex with courts, fields, fitness equipment, and a pavilion.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists sand-volleyball, basketball, and tennis/pickleball courts, grass fields, an outdoor fitness area, and a pavilion at Shoreline Sports Complex.
cards.access_notes: Current UNCW students, faculty/staff, and their guests may use it; scheduled activities take priority. Facility page lists lights until 11 p.m. during the academic year.
